title: 替换算法对比：LRU / FIFO / 随机 / OPT 与 Belady 异常
expected_output:
=== replacement policies on a fixed reference string ===
  reference string: [1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  (associative ways play the role of page frames)

  ways       FIFO      LRU     random      OPT
  3             9       10          9        7
  4            10        8          6        6

=== Belady anomaly (FIFO only) ===
  FIFO with 3 ways  -> 9 misses
  FIFO with 4 ways  -> 10 misses
  MORE capacity produced MORE misses: YES, anomaly reproduced
  LRU with 3 -> 10, with 4 -> 8  (never increases)
  OPT with 3 -> 7, with 4 -> 6  (the theoretical lower bound)

why: LRU and OPT are STACK algorithms. The resident set with C ways is always a
     subset of the resident set with C+1 ways, so hit rate can never drop.
     FIFO does not have that property, so it can suffer the anomaly.
     OPT is unimplementable (it needs the future) -- it only bounds the others.
